Commentary.Commentary: It was a brilliant bowling performance from England with Ali being the standout while Jordan and Mills were excellent too, especially at the death. Stokes and Plunkett were slightly expensive but picked vital wickets. The track is two-paced and slower balls might be difficult to score. Still, India are about 15 runs short on the pitch. Advantage England at this stage but if no dew comes up, India's spinners can shine. Join us in a while for the chase.

Excellent performance from England after opting to bowl. Kohli and Raina got starts but failed to get going as wickets kept falling at regular intervals for the hosts. India were never really able to get momentum in the innings and eventually meandered past the 145-run mark which was due to a handy unbeaten knock from Dhoni who however couldn't finish it the way he would have wanted to.

Not out! Fuller on middle, Dhoni muscles the drive down towards long on. They charge fore the second run as the throw comes in flat from the deep. Jordan collects it and whips off the bails. They go upstairs to refer it. Bumrah is just in and so that's a bonus run to the total. INDIA FINISH ON 147/7.
They are going upstairs for the run out.
Dhoni misses out! Full toss and he carts it hard but straight towards mid off. Either side of the fielder and it would have been a boundary.
JASPRIT BUMRAH is the new man in.

OUT! Rasool sacrifices himself! Full and outside off, Dhoni blasts it to Morgan at extra cover. Obviously, he never wanted a single but Rasool is way down the track already. Too late to return back as the throw from Morgan is easily collected by Jordan who does the rest.

FOUR! Back to back boundaries! Just the kind of finish India are looking for. Full ball wide outside off, right line to Dhoni but he gets the chance of getting underneath the ball. Slams it hard to the left of the sweeper cover fielder for a fence.

FOUR! HAMMERED! Jordan misses the yorker and Dhoni is waiting for that length. Clobbers the full ball straight back past the bowler as it races to the long on fence for a boundary. Sheer power from the veteran finisher.

RUN OUT MISSED! Low full toss and Dhoni bludgeons it back at Jordan who gets a hand on it to parry it towards long on. They race back for the second but Rasool was a goner had Jordan gathered the throw well at the bowler's end.
Slower ball on back of a length at 107 kph, Dhoni is foxed by the change of pace and gets an inside edge on to the pads while trying the pull. Single taken.
Slower ball outside off, Rasool leans forward and pushes it towards point. Single taken.
Back of a length on middle, Dhoni looks to whip it away on the leg side but gets an inside edge on to the pads as the ball drops in front of him. They steal a single.
Slower bouncer outside off, Dhoni was winding up for the big pull but then adjusts to shovel it past short fine leg where Rashid was too slow. A brace taken.
Short outside off, Rasool mistimes the pull towards long on. Single taken.
Back of a length outside off, slapped towards deep point for a single.
Top yorker around off, Dhoni can only dig it out towards mid off for a single. Excellent death bowling from England. They are just not giving anything away at all.
Rasool misses the flick and the ball rolls off the pads towards short fine leg. They take a leg bye.
Low full toss and Dhoni mistimes the heave down to long on. Just a single.
Clever bowling! Sees Dhoni's charge and fires a wide yorker. No shot offered expecting the wide but it was well inside the tramline.
Some discomfort for Dhoni in his eye.
Fuller on middle, whipped away to the right of long on and Dhoni eggs his partner back for the second run.
Dug in short on middle, Rasool swivels and mistimes the pull through square leg for a single.
CHRIS JORDAN comes back into the attack.
Shortish outside off, steered down to third man for a single. Top over, a wicket and just 5 off it.
Back of a length outside off, gets back and taps it to point for a single.
Length ball on middle, worked on the leg side for a single.
Full and outside off, pushed towards cover for a single.
The debutant, PARVEZ RASOOL, comes out to bat.

OUT! FIRST T20I WICKET FOR MILLS! Back of a length outside off, Pandya backs away to flat bat it away but mistimes it high towards sweeper cover. Extra bounce does the trick and that's an easy catch for Billings. India's innings continues to implode.
Slower bouncer at 111 kph well outside off, Dhoni waits and fetches the pull towards square leg for a single.
TYMAL MILLS is back on.
Good length on leg stump, Dhoni gets across to flick but misses. The batsmen get a leg bye towards short fine leg.
Full and outside off, drilled towards sweeper cover for a single.
Shocker from Stokes! Slower ball at 101 kph, way down the leg side and that is a big wide.
Dug in short around off, Pandya swivels for the mighty pull but gets it off the splice on to the track. Beaten for pace.
Too straight from Stokes and Dhoni works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Fast cutter but well outside off, that's a wide.
FOUR! PUMMELED! One of Dhoni's favorite strokes, this. Fuller ball outside off, opens the face slightly to power the drive through the covers as the ball rockets to the fence. Excellent placement.
Back of a length outside off, punched sweetly to short extra cover where Morgan makes a fine half-stop with a dive. Parries it towards mid off as the batsmen get a single.

Full and down the leg side, Pandya goes for the flick as the ball goes down the leg side to the keeper. There seemed to be some sound, probably ball clipping pad but the umpire gives it a wide. Strangely, no reaction from the Englishmen either! Hmm...
BEN STOKES is back for his final over.
Fuller outside off, Dhoni lunges forward and pushes it towards cover.
Shortish outside off, gets back and steers it down to third man for a single.

PANDYA ESCAPES! After three dot balls, he looks for the getaway stroke and mistimes the pull. Just gets it over a diving short mid-wicket fielder as the ball goes towards wide long on. Stokes runs across to put a superb diving half-stop and gathers himself quickly to make a second stop. Brace taken.
Length ball on off, gets across and jabs it towards short mid-wicket.
Fuller on middle, Pandya finds the short mid-wicket fielder again, this time with a flick.
Back of a length on off, blocked solidly off the back foot to short mid-wicket.
LIAM PLUNKETT is back.
Very full on middle, drilled down to long on for a single. Ends an excellent spell for Moeen, 4-0-21-2. Brilliant!
Floated on middle, Dhoni charges down the track and takes it on the full. Whips it away to long on for a single.
Flatter on a length outside off, Pandya stays back and steers it past short third man. Doesn't make the fence but they get three more.
Fuller outside off, presses forward and blocks it well.
HARDIK PANDYA walks out to bat.

OUT! ALI HAS ANOTHER! Excellent phase this for England and the Indians are in trouble now. Floated around off, Pandey misses the flick and is rapped on the pads. That looked plumb to the naked eye and the umpire's finger goes up instantly. Pandey fails to impress. What a spell this is turning out to be from Moeen!
On a length around off, worked off the back foot towards short mid-wicket.
Shortish around off, worked on the leg side for a single.
Shortish outside off, punched off the back foot towards mid off.
Back of a length outside off, steered through backward point. Great running gives them a brace.
MANISH PANDEY is the new man in.

OUT! STOKES HAS HIS REVENGE! Brilliant leg stump yorker and Raina misses the flick as he tries to shuffle across the stumps but misses. He had been moving far too across the sticks from the start today and ultimately, it costs him. Vital wicket this for England as Raina was looking deadly.

SIX! MASSIVE! Raina goes big although not off the middle of the bat. Generates so much power. Shortish from Stokes and Raina makes room to maul the pull over deep mid-wicket for a maximum. It went high and also cleared the ropes comfortably.
Good length on middle and leg, Dhoni nudges it down to fine leg for a single.
BEN STOKES is back on for another spell.
Darted on the pads, Dhoni gets across and powers it through square leg for a single to keep strike.
Flatter outside off, punched down the ground to long off for a single.
Floated around leg stump, Raina gets across to sweep but gets it off the toe end towards short fine leg.
Drifting in around off, Dhoni steps out again for the big shot but Ali cleverly shortens the length. Flicked towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Floated around off, Dhoni steps out and clips it through mid-wicket. Good running and a brace taken.
Fuller on the pads, Raina gets across and nudges it past mid-wicket for a single.
Almost carried! Full toss on the pads and Raina looks to lift it over square leg. Mistimes it a bit and almost carries to the fielder there. Single taken.

FOUR! CLEARS THE INFIELD! Raina is motoring along well here. Steps out and makes room to play the inside out lofted stroke over extra cover to a length ball. Aerial but also in the gap to find the fence.
Fuller outside off, Dhoni gets across and thumps it down to long on for a single.
Full and on the pads, gets across and clips it through square leg for a single.
Dug in short around off, Raina gets across and then lets it pass over his head.
MS DHONI is the new man in.

OUT! SOFT DISMISSAL! Shortish around leg stump, Yuvraj gets across to whip it away but the ball stops a touch off the surface. He is early into the stroke and pops a leading edge that goes towards deep fine leg. Rashid comes forward and takes a tumbling catch. The umpires go upstairs to check it if the catch is clean with the soft signal being out. The third umpire is convinced that the catch is clean and so Yuvraj has to go. India slipping a bit at this stage.
LIAM PLUNKETT is back on.
Played with the angle through mid-wicket for a single. India are 75/2 after 10 overs! How much can they add more in the next 10?
FOUR! Straight down the ground! Tossed up on middle and off, Yuvi stands tall and lofts it over the bowler's head. No chance for anyone to stop it and the ball crosses the fence on one bounce.
Gets an inside edge to it! Tossed up delivery, Yuvi looks to go for a big slog. Gets early into his shot, and goes off the inside edge to short fine leg.
Sliding into the pads, driven to long on for a single.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
On the pads, flicked on the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Nicely done! Length delivery outside off, Suresh stays back and guides it past backward point. Beats Rashid in the deep and gets a boundary for it.

On a length and angling across, YS punches it off the back foot through widish mid off. Plunkett from mid off makes a poor attempt to stop the ball and pays the price. Three runs taken off that misfield!
Angling away from Yuvi, he pokes at it but misses.
Length delivery, angling away, punched off the back foot to mid off.
Angling across Raina, he dances down and lofts it over covers. There's protection in the deep and only a single is taken!
Wide! Banged in short. It's too short and is called wide for height!
Back of a length delivery, slapped through backward point for a single.
Landed outside off, driven to long off for a single.
Sliding into the pads, worked down the leg side for a single.
Full outside off, pushed through mid off for a single.
Singh dances down the track, seeing this, Ali drags his length back and beats Yuvi. Luckily for Yuvi that the ball hits him and doesn't go through to the keeper. Else, he would have been stumped.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
YUVRAJ SINGH is the new man in!

OUT! Massive blow for India! Ali strikes straightaway! Tossed up outside off, Kohli uses his feet, tries to get to the pitch of the ball doesn't get to it. Still manages to whip it uppishly with power. It's traveling like a tracer bullet and Morgan at short mid-wicket takes a good sharp catch! England are super delighted and the crowd has gone silent at Kanpur!
MOEEN ALI comes on to bowl.
Angling into the pads, flicked on the leg side for a single.
Angling across Raina, he guides it to third man for a single.
Full outside off, driven through covers for a single.
Leg bye! Mild lbw shout turned down! On the pads, Raina misses his flick and gets it off the pads on the leg side. The appeal is turned down as it was pitched outside leg. A leg bye is taken!
Wide! Back of a length delivery outside leg, Raina gets across and looks to drag it on its way but misses. A wide is signalled! A little harsh that on the bowler as the batsman had move across.
Outside leg, angling towards the stumps, Suresh gets across and glances it through backward square leg for a brace.
Pitched outside off, tapped in the mid off region for a single.
BEN STOKES is introduced into the attack!

FOUR! Mistimes it to the boundary! Full outside off, SR looks to take Plunkett downtown. Doesn't middle it but manages to clear the infield and one bounce into the fence as it's a small ground. 47/1 at the end of Powerplay!
Length delivery outside off, VK covers his stumps and guides it to third man for a single.
On the pads, clipped jsut in front of square on the leg side for a single.

FOUR! That's a risky shot! Length delivery, angling away, Raina steps down the track and looks to go over covers. However, the bat turns in his hand and the ball slices over backward point. Rashid from third man comes running in but fails to cut it out. A boundary is signalled!
Timely driven but straight to the man at mid off. Unlucky there, Raina!
On the pads, flicked on the leg side for a single.
Slower one down leg, worked on its way to short fine leg for a single.
On the pads, tucked with soft hands through mid-wicket for a single.
Pitched outside off, pushed off the back foot to mid off.
SURESH RAINA is the new man to walk in!

OUT! Rahul once again falls cheaply! Jordan with the breakthrough! Banged in short, Rahul looks to pull it but ends up top edging it high in the air. Rashid at short fine leg has to move a couple of steps before completing an easy catch. Another failure for Rahul! England are delighted!
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot to mid on.
On the pads, flicked through square leg for a single.
CHRIS JORDAN has change of ends!
On the pads, worked on the leg side for a single. 11 runs off the over!
Back of a length delivery, angling in, Rahul looks to work it but gets hit on the gloves. The batsman goes on the leg side and they take a quick single. Rahul looks to be in pain after that!
Defended with soft hands on the off side for a quick single.
Good comeback from Plunkett! Back of a length delivery outside off, rises a touch extra, beats Kohli on his cut.
FOUR! This time VK hits it cleanly! Fullish outside off, lofts it over wide mid off and gets a boundary for it. Not the start Plunkett wanted!

FOUR! In the air... but safe! A touch fuller outside off, Virat opts to go uppishly. Mistimes it but still manages to get it over covers. Roy chasing it down fails to stop it before the fence. He dashes into one of the ball boys and is a touch furious. But, in the end offers a hand to the ball boy to get him up on the feet. Boundary is signalled!
LIAM PLUNKETT comes on to bowl.
Slower one outside off, Rahul adjusts well and defends it to point.
On a length and outside off, guided through to third man for a single.
Edged but safe! Fuller length outside off, Lokesh looks to drive it on the up but gets manages to get a thick edge past first slip through to third man for a single.
Wide! Angling down leg, Rahul looks to drag it but misses. Wide is signaled!

Sloppy from England! Fullish outside off, tapped to cover-point. Kohli from the bowler's end takes off and completes it easily. Morgan charges down and takes an aim at the striker's end and hits. The ball deflects and they take an overthrow as well. Two runs added to the total!
Banged in short, Rahul leaves it watchfully.
Pitched outside off, keeps a touch low, Kohli gets tall and works it through mid-wicket gently for a single.
Slower one again, worked just in front of square on the leg side for a single. Kohli will retain the strike!
Slower one! Kohli is beaten there as he gets early into his shot. Good comeback from Jordan!
FOUR! Kohli connects and gets a boundary for it! On length and angling in, Kohli lofts it over mid on, clears the infield easily and gets a boundary for it.
Length delivery outside off, another swing and a miss from Kohli.
Wide! Down the leg side, Kohli leaves it. Wide signalled!
Wide outside off, VK looks to slash it but misses. There's a mild appeal from behind but not given. Kohli asks Rahul if it was wide or not and that too isn't given. Dot ball!
Misses out on the Free Hit! On length and wide outside off, Kohli swings his bat hard without watching the ball closely and misses.
Free Hit coming up!

NO BALL! Fullish delivery outside off, Virat looks to drive it on the up through point. Times it nicely but Roy present there gets to his right and cuts it out. However, Jordan has overstepped and it's a massive one. Not the start Jordan would have hoped for!
CHRIS JORDAN to bowl from the other end.
FOUR! Takes the aerial route! Short and width on offer, Rahul cuts it over backward point and the ball races to the fence. 9 runs off the over!
Angling away from Rahul, left alone.
On the pads, tucked on the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Back of a length outside off, angling across, VK punches it through cover-point. Gets off the mark with a boundary!
Angling towards the pads, Kohli misses his flick and gets rapped up on the thigh pad.
Back of a length delivery, angling away, Kohli gets on hi toes and defends it on the off side.

The national anthems of both the teams are done and dusted. LOKESH RAHUL and VIRAT KOHLI to open for India. TYMAL MILLS to start the proceedings with the ball. It's a packed crowd out there, set for an entertaining one. Let's play...
India (Playing XI): Lokesh Rahul, Manish Pandey, Virat Kohli(c), Yuvraj Singh, Suresh Raina, MS Dhoni(w), Hardik Pandya, Parvez Rasool, Yuzvendra Chahal, Jasprit Bumrah, Ashish Nehra.
England (Playing XI): Jason Roy, Sam Billings, Joe Root, Eoin Morgan(c), Ben Stokes, Jos Buttler(w), Moeen Ali, Chris Jordan, Liam Plunkett, Adil Rashid, Tymal Mills.

VIRAT KOHLI says that he would have bowled first too but maintains that toss isn't something a captain can control. Hopes that his side can start well and do the basics right. Reflects on the good mix of youth and experience in the side as a good point for the team. Expects that it will be a very good batting pitch. Says that PARVEZ RASOOL is making his debut. Mandeep Singh, Amit Mishra, Ajinkya Rahane and Rishabh Pant are the ones missing out.

EOIN MORGAN says that England will bowl. Feels that the win in the final ODI series was a confidence booster and adds that it was a hardly fought duel there. Hopes that his side can keep up the winning momentum in this series as well. Feels that it is tough to predict a par score and maintains that it is a good pitch. Jake Ball, Jonny Bairstow, David Willey (injury) and Liam Dawson are the ones missing out for England.
Time for the toss. Kohli flips the coin, heads is the call from Morgan and it is a head. ENGLAND WIN THE TOSS AND OPT TO BOWL.

Hello and a warm welcome to the first T20I between India and England at the Green Park, Kanpur on India's 68th Republic Day. After winning both the Test and the ODI series, India would look upon winning the T20I series as well. They have a strong squad and are the favourites to win. Morgan and co. on the other hand would be coming into this match with gaining some momentum after their win in the previous ODI. It's aiming to be a great contest between bat and ball and surely an entertaining one!
